description: This file implements the LanguageService class in PHP, providing methods to manage language entities such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and checking for existing language records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for language management, interfacing between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: getLanguageDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LanguageDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: setLanguageDao
methods.description: Sets the LanguageDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves a new language or updates an existing one by delegating to the DAO.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching specific search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of languages ordered by name, filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple language records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language name already exists, case-insensitive.
